title: 자기소개
intro: OPIc 첫 질문은 거의 항상 'Tell me about yourself.' 자기소개입니다. 채점 비중은 낮지만 첫인상을 만들고, 여기서 말한 정보(서울 IT 회사 마케팅팀 직장인, 회사 근처 아파트에서 혼자 거주, 친구·영화 좋아함)가 뒤에 나올 집·동네·영화·여행 답변의 밑바탕이 됩니다. 모범 영상처럼 짧고 쉬운 문장 7~8개로 40초 안에 끝내는 것이 목표입니다.
strategy: 답변 흐름: 'Okay, let me tell you about myself.' → 이름·직업(IT 회사 마케팅팀) → 사는 곳(회사 근처 아파트, 혼자) → 일상(회의가 많아 바쁨) → 여가(친구, 영화) → 'Yeah, that's a short introduction about myself.'
설문에서 직장인을 골랐다면 회사·업무 질문이 이어서 나옵니다. 팀(마케팅팀 6명), 업무(SNS 캠페인 기획·보고서·회의), 입사 동기 Minji를 미리 정해 두면 어떤 질문에도 같은 이야기로 답할 수 있어요.
'pretty busy', 'hanging out with my friends'처럼 실제로 말하는 쉬운 표현을 쓰고, 어려운 단어로 길게 늘이지 않습니다.
IH 이상은 이유(because)·빈도(about three times a week)·성격 한두 줄을 덧붙여 길이를 늘립니다.

expressions.en: Okay, let me tell you about myself.
I'm currently working at an IT company in Seoul.
expressions.ko: 저는 지금 서울에 있는 IT 회사에서 일하고 있어요.
expressions.note: work at / work for + 회사 둘 다 자연스러워요

expressions.en: I live alone in a small apartment near my office.
expressions.ko: 회사 근처 작은 아파트에서 혼자 살아요.

expressions.en: My daily life is pretty busy because I usually have a lot of meetings.
expressions.ko: 보통 회의가 많아서 일상이 꽤 바빠요.

expressions.en: In my free time, I like hanging out with my friends.
expressions.ko: 여가 시간에는 친구들이랑 어울려 노는 걸 좋아해요.

expressions.en: I also like watching movies at home.
It takes about 15 minutes to get to work by subway.
I've been working there for about three years.
I'd say I'm a pretty cheerful and outgoing person.
expressions.ko: 저는 꽤 밝고 외향적인 사람인 것 같아요.

expressions.en: My coworker Minji and I joined the company at the same time, so we're really close.
expressions.ko: 동료 Minji와 저는 입사 동기라서 정말 친해요.
expressions.note: joined the company at the same time: 입사 동기

expressions.en: When I get stressed out at work, I usually go jogging or listen to music.
expressions.ko: 회사에서 스트레스를 받으면 보통 조깅을 하거나 음악을 들어요.

expressions.en: So yeah, that's pretty much who I am.
I wouldn't say my job is easy, but it's definitely rewarding.
expressions.ko: 제 일이 쉽다고는 못 하겠지만, 확실히 보람은 있어요.
expressions.note: I wouldn't say ~, but ~: 부드러운 양보

expressions.en: Watching a movie on Friday night is my go-to way to unwind after a long week.
expressions.ko: 금요일 밤에 영화 보는 게 긴 한 주를 보내고 쉬는 제 단골 방법이에요.

questions.en: Let's start the interview now. Please tell me a little bit about yourself.
questions.ko: 이제 인터뷰를 시작하겠습니다. 자기소개를 간단히 해 주세요.
tips: 답변 흐름: 시작 문장 → 이름·직업 → 사는 곳 → 바쁜 일상 → 여가 → 'Yeah, that's ~' 마무리
IM3 답안은 모범 영상 답변을 직장인 버전으로 바꾼 것입니다. 문장 단위로 통째로 외워 두세요.
'I'm on the marketing team', 'pretty busy'처럼 짧고 쉬운 표현이 오히려 자연스럽게 들립니다.

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you about myself. My name is Jenny. I'm currently working at an IT company in Seoul. I'm on the marketing team. I live alone in a small apartment near my office. My daily life is pretty busy because I usually have a lot of meetings. In my free time, I like hanging out with my friends or watching movies at home. Yeah, that's a short introduction about myself.
answers.IH: Okay, let me tell you about myself. My name is Jenny, and I'm in my late twenties. I'm currently working at an IT company in Seoul, near Seongsu. I'm on the marketing team, and I've been working there for about three years. I live alone in a small apartment near my office. It only takes about 15 minutes to get to work by subway, which is really nice. My family lives in Daejeon, so I visit them during the holidays. My daily life is pretty busy because I usually have a lot of meetings. But I don't mind it that much, because my coworker Minji is on the same team, and we're really close. In my free time, I like hanging out with my friends at cafes or watching movies at home. I'd say I'm a pretty cheerful person, and I really love being around people. Yeah, that's a short introduction about myself.
answers.AL: Okay, let me tell you about myself. My name is Jenny, and I'm in my late twenties. I'm currently working at an IT company in Seoul, and I'm on the marketing team. I majored in business in college, so marketing felt like a natural fit for me. I've been with the company for about three years now. I live alone in a small one-bedroom apartment near my office. My family lives in Daejeon, so moving out on my own was a big change at first, but now I really enjoy having my own space. To be honest, my daily life is pretty busy. I usually have a lot of meetings, and some days I barely have time to check my email. Luckily, my coworker Minji and I joined the company at the same time, so we get through the stressful days together. When I finally get some free time, I like hanging out with my friends. We usually try a new restaurant or chat at a cafe for hours. On quieter nights, I'd rather stay in and watch a movie at home. I'd say I'm a cheerful and outgoing person, but I also need some time to recharge. So when work gets stressful, I go jogging along the Han River or just put on some music. Yeah, that's pretty much who I am in a nutshell.

questions.en: Tell me more about yourself. What kind of person are you, and what do you like to do in your free time?
questions.ko: 자신에 대해 좀 더 말해 주세요. 어떤 성격이고, 여가 시간에는 무엇을 하는 걸 좋아하나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Sure, I'd love to talk about that.' → 성격 2가지 → 취미 2~3개와 빈도 → 취미가 주는 느낌 → 'Yeah, that's ~' 마무리
성격은 'I'd say I'm ~'로 부드럽게, 취미는 영화·음악·조깅처럼 뒤 주제와 연결되는 것으로 고르세요.
'about three times a week', 'on Friday nights' 같은 빈도 표현을 꼭 넣으세요.

answers.IM3: Sure, I'd love to talk about that. I think I'm a cheerful and friendly person. I really like being with people. My closest coworker is Minji, and we're on the same team. In my free time, I like watching movies at home. I usually watch comedies or action movies on Netflix on Friday nights. I also listen to music a lot, especially K-pop. And I go jogging about three times a week. Yeah, that's what I'm like.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about that. I'd say I'm a pretty cheerful and outgoing person. I love being around people, and my friends say I'm easy to talk to. My coworker Minji and I joined the company at the same time, so we hang out a lot, usually at cafes or nice restaurants after work. But I also need some quiet time, especially after a week full of meetings. That's when I watch movies at home. On Friday nights, I usually watch a comedy or an action movie on Netflix. Music is also a big part of my day. I always listen to K-pop or ballads on the subway, and my favorite singer is IU. And to stay healthy, I go jogging along the Han River about three times a week. These hobbies really help me relieve stress. Yeah, that's pretty much what I'm like.
answers.AL: Sure, I'd love to talk about that. I'd describe myself as a cheerful and outgoing person. I really enjoy being around people, and my coworkers often tell me I'm the one who keeps the mood light in meetings. My coworker Minji and I joined the company at the same time, so we've become really close. We often grab dinner after work or try a new cafe on the weekend. That said, I'm not out every night. Since I live alone, I actually love having quiet nights at home to recharge, and that's when movies come in. On Friday nights, I love curling up on the sofa and watching a comedy or an action movie on Netflix. Music is another big part of my life. I've always got my earphones in on the subway, usually listening to K-pop or ballads, and IU is my all-time favorite singer. On top of that, I go jogging along the Han River about three times a week. It only takes thirty minutes, but it clears my head like nothing else. So whenever work gets stressful, I've got movies, music, and jogging to fall back on. Yeah, that's pretty much what I'm like.

questions.en: Tell me about a typical weekday for you. What do you do from the time you get up until you go to bed?
questions.ko: 평일 일상에 대해 말해 주세요. 일어나서 잠들 때까지 무엇을 하나요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Okay, let me tell you about my weekday.' → 아침 → 출근(지하철 15분) → 회사(회의·점심) → 퇴근 후 저녁 → 잠자기 전 → 'Yeah, that's ~' 마무리
시간 순서 표현 first, after that, then, after work를 쓰면 흐름이 깔끔해요.
'I get off work at six' / 'I work from home on Fridays' 같은 직장인 표현을 넣어 보세요.

answers.IM3: Okay, let me tell you about my weekday. I get up at seven thirty. I take a quick shower and have a simple breakfast. Then I take the subway to work. It only takes about 15 minutes. I start work at nine. I usually have a lot of meetings, so it's pretty busy. I have lunch with my coworkers near the office. I get off work at six. Then I go jogging or cook dinner at home. I go to bed around midnight. Yeah, that's my typical weekday.
answers.IH: Okay, let me tell you about my typical weekday. I usually get up at seven thirty, take a quick shower, and have a simple breakfast, like toast and coffee. I leave home around eight thirty and take the subway to work. It only takes about 15 minutes, and I listen to music on the way. I start work at nine, and my mornings are pretty busy because I usually have two or three meetings. At lunchtime, I eat with Minji and other coworkers at a restaurant near the office. In the afternoon, I work on reports or plan our social media campaigns. I get off work at six. About three times a week, I go jogging along the Han River. Then I make a simple dinner and watch a short video before bed. I try to go to bed by midnight. Oh, and on Fridays, I work from home. Yeah, that's what my weekdays look like.
answers.AL: Okay, let me tell you about a typical weekday for me. My alarm goes off at seven thirty, and honestly, getting out of bed is the hardest part of my day. After a quick shower, I make some toast and coffee. Since I live alone, my mornings are pretty quiet, and I actually enjoy that peaceful time. I'm out the door by eight thirty and on the subway, which gets me to the office in about 15 minutes. I always have my earphones in, so it's kind of my little music time before things get crazy. And they do get crazy, because I usually have meetings back to back all morning. Around noon, I grab lunch with Minji and a few other coworkers near the office, and we complain about our deadlines together. In the afternoon, I sit at my desk by the window and work on reports or plan our next social media campaign. I get off work at six, and three nights a week, I go jogging along the Han River to clear my head. After that, I cook something simple and finally relax on the sofa. I try to be asleep by midnight, though that doesn't always happen. Fridays are a bit different, because I work from home. Yeah, that's pretty much my weekday in a nutshell.

questions.en: You indicated in the survey that you work at a company. Tell me about your job and your company. What do you do, and what is a typical day at work like?
questions.ko: 설문에서 회사에 다닌다고 하셨는데요. 직업과 회사에 대해 말해 주세요. 어떤 일을 하고, 회사에서의 하루는 어떤가요?
tips: 답변 흐름: 'Sure, I'd love to talk about my job.' → 회사·팀·근무 기간 → 맡은 업무 → 회사에서의 하루 → 좋은 점/힘든 점 → 'Yeah, that's ~' 마무리
'I'm in charge of ~' / 'What I like most about my job is that ~'을 활용하세요.
회의, 보고서 마감, 캠페인 결과처럼 직장인다운 구체적 디테일을 하나 넣으면 IH 이상이 됩니다.

answers.IM3: Sure, I'd love to talk about my job. I work at an IT company in Seoul. It's a mid-sized company near Seongsu. I'm on the marketing team, and there are six people on my team. I plan social media campaigns and write reports. I have a lot of meetings, so my days are pretty busy. My office is on the ninth floor, and my desk is by the window. My coworker Minji is on my team, too. Yeah, that's my job.
answers.IH: Sure, I'd love to talk about my job. I work at a mid-sized IT company near Seongsu in Seoul, and I've been there for about three years. I'm on the marketing team. There are six people on my team, including my team leader. I'm mainly in charge of planning social media campaigns for our apps. On a typical day, I start work at nine and have two or three meetings in the morning. Then I have lunch with my coworkers at a restaurant near the office. In the afternoon, I check how our campaigns are doing and write reports. What I like most about my job is that I can see the results of my ideas right away. To be honest, deadlines can be really stressful. But my teammates are great, especially Minji, who joined the company with me. Yeah, that's pretty much my job.
answers.AL: Sure, I'd love to talk about my job. I work at a mid-sized IT company near Seongsu in Seoul, and this is actually my fourth year there. I'm on the marketing team, which is a small team of six people, including my team leader. I'm mainly in charge of planning social media campaigns for our apps, and I also write a lot of reports. I majored in business in college, so this job felt like a perfect fit. On a typical day, I get to the office a little before nine. Our office is on the ninth floor, and I'm lucky enough to have a desk by the window. My mornings are usually packed with meetings, so I barely have time to check my email. Around noon, I grab lunch with my coworkers at one of the restaurants nearby. In the afternoon, I look at how our campaigns are doing and put together reports for my team leader. What I like most about my job is that I can see the results of my ideas right away. I'll admit the deadlines can be brutal, but Minji and I joined the company at the same time, so we always help each other out. Yeah, that's pretty much what my job looks like.

pronunciation.tip: '컴퍼니'. 첫 음절 '컴'에 강세, o는 '오'가 아니라 '어' 소리
'마케팅'이 아니라 '마r키딩'. 첫 음절에 강세, t는 부드럽게 굴려요
'커런틀리'. 첫 음절에 강세, t는 거의 삼키듯
